function: Joint downlink precoding vectors and fronthaul compression noise covariances in cell-free MIMO, by unfolding an iterative gradient-descent algorithm into a network; maximizes sum-rate (pp. 2, 6-7).
system: Downlink cell-free MIMO: 7 stripe-linked plus 3 star-linked APs with N=2 antennas each, K=5 single-antenna users, Rayleigh fading, no RIS, carrier band not stated (pp. 3, 7).
method: Deep unfolding network, T=10 layers unrolling the IGD algorithm, 2T trainable step sizes; unsupervised training on negative sum-rate loss with Adam (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Own simulated Rayleigh fading with distance path loss (exponent 3) and 10% estimation-error variance; training set of 100 batches of 64 channel realizations; no public data (p. 7).
test_conditions: Training described only for the default setup (Table II); evaluation sweeps fronthaul 30-50 bps and 5-10 users, plus user-centric case; whether DUNN is retrained is not stated (pp. 7-10).
baselines: Non-learned only: the authors' own AO algorithm and IGD algorithm (10 and 100 iterations), plus stripe-only topology benchmark; no earlier learned method or standard network compared (pp. 8-9).
metrics: Sum-rate in bps, percentage of the AO sum-rate, average computation time per sample, convergence versus iteration number (pp. 8-10).
complexity: Orders of complexity for AO, IGD, and DUNN (pp. 5-7); 2T trainable parameters (p. 2); DUNN runtime about 0.03 s per sample, AO about 3000 times slower (pp. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 7: "The wireless channel follows Rayleigh fading". Custom Rayleigh model with own distance path loss; no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 7: "dataset consists of 100 batches, with each batch containing" 64 channel realizations of the default setup. The paper never states that a trained DUNN is tested at another number of users (Fig. 7a), fronthaul capacity (Fig. 6a) or in the user-centric case (Fig. 8), nor whether it is retrained for them; "is scalable since the trainable parameters are independent of the system size" (p. 7) is a claim about the architecture, not a reported test.
q3_support: p. 8: "i.e., the AO algorithm, the IGD algorithm, and the DUNN". AO and IGD are non-learned and the authors' own; no earlier learned method for the same function and no standard network (FC, CNN, LSTM) is compared.
q4_support: p. 7: "the overall complexity of the DUNN is" approximately O(T K N^3 M^3 + ...); p. 10: "approximately 0.03 seconds per sample" for the DUNN, with the AO algorithm about 3000 times slower.
q5_support: p. 7: "dataset consists of 100 batches, with each batch containing" 64 channel realizations. The data are the authors' own simulated channels; no code or data link or DOI appears anywhere in the 12 pages, and no public dataset is used.
notes: Area 3: the learned function is the base-station precoder; fronthaul compression noise covariances are optimized jointly, with sum-rate as the main metric, so the reviewer may confirm area 3. q2 is 0 only because the paper is silent on retraining in the sweeps of Figs. 6a, 7a and 8. q3 is 0 because there is no learned baseline.
